name: Random Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity of Full Cube
proof: Proper random equivalence queries are a restriction of random equivalence queries, so $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{rpeq}}\geq\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{req}}=n$ on the full cube. The established proper random-equivalence upper bound is $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{rpeq}}\leq\log_2|\mathcal H|$, and the full cube has size $2^n$. Hence $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{rpeq}}=n$.
